learning_outcomes.text: Develop a deeper understanding of the general QMS vocabulary and identify the guidelines of the QMS approach via ISO 9001 version 2015.
Be able to identify Quality tools and methods adapted to the context, in the face of risks and opportunities.
Know how to use basic Quality tools: Lean, 5S, Ishikawa, 5M, Pareto, quality circles, group work, ...
Know how to deploy an approach to integrate QSE management systems by merging ISO 9001, 14001, and 45000 standards.
Understand and implement the main Quality tools.

Understand the structure of ISO 9001 version 2015 and all the requirements of ISO 9001 - 14001 & 45001 standards and identify the main labels and certifications for the integration of QSE management systems.

degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
